newsitem.title: USA: Fine Air says decides to rescind offering.
newsitem.headline: Fine Air says decides to rescind offering.

text.p: Fine Air Services Inc said Friday it has decided to rescind its recent public offering. Citing the belief that the crash of one of its jets will not have a material adverse effect on the company, it said it will promptly circulate an updated prospectus to investors.

The company said the DC-8-61F jet which crashed on takeoff Thursday near Miami International Airport was fully insured, and its liability insurance "more than adequate" to satisfy any claims arising from the accident.
The company said its managing underwriters expect to return to the market with a similar offering at the same price range of $13-$15 per share within the next 30 days.
In addition, the company said its remaining aircraft provide adequate lift capacity for its current needs, and it believes a replacement aircraft can be obtained in a "timely basis."
All four people aboard the plane were presumed dead. Two people on the ground suffered minor injuries.
